title: Controlled Dependency-Closed Temporal Certificate Materialization onto WOF42 Spine

negative_regression_authority.required_sentinel: invalid negative/NaN/+Inf supplied H_budget must retain the native supplied diagnostic value while fail-closing certificate availability

goal: Materialize the smallest dependency-closed production temporal subsystem onto the exact WOF42 source postimage without whole-branch merging, while preserving newer WOF42 crop/runtime/persistence work and all SWAP architecture invariants.
hard_rules: Do not merge the F-KT11 branch wholesale.
Do not replace shared WOF42 files wholesale merely because an older temporal branch is green.
Determine the transitive production dependency closure before first src change.
For shared changed files, port only the required semantics and preserve WOF42 additions unless source equivalence is proven.
Persist the exact materialized source postimage before long replay tests.
A historical PASS does not transfer automatically to this new tree.
F-VQ33 remains negative evidence and is a mandatory regression sentinel.
Hard mass qualification remains independent and precedes the temporal certificate gate.
No default H_budget may be introduced.
B_inf is not a general nonlinear true-error bound.
No shorter-dt monotonicity assumption may be introduced.
No canonical ref update is permitted in F-CI21.

F-KT10_transaction_history.semantic_requirement: feature-scoped previous accepted right-derivative continuation state is transaction-owned; clone/checkpoint/trial/reject/commit semantics preserve rollback and publish only on explicit commit

F-KT11_policy_binding.semantic_requirement: explicit finite positive supplied H_budget, C_h=B_inf/H_budget, unavailable fail-closed, mass before certificate, exact rollback, raw native invalid-budget diagnostics retained

required_replay_after_materialization: F-KT12/F-KT13 preservation if transaction/persistence context changes
F-KT11 owner policy matrix including negative/NaN/+Inf native diagnostics
F-VQ33 failed diagnostic case as regression sentinel
